title: Noor and the Summer
author: Rafael Almeida
blurb: Ines Ishikawa, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
